name: Shadow Dragon King
description: A sovereign of absolute darkness, the Shadow Dragon King commands the void itself. Its twin obsidian horns pierce the fabric of the stadium as it consumes all light, growing into an unstoppable force once Dark Void is unleashed.

special_move.name: Dark Void
special_move.description: The Shadow Dragon King tears open a void of absolute darkness — a singularity of draconic power that deals devastating true damage, piercing all barriers and defenses without exception. Activating this move triggers Absolute Darkness, and Dark Weather amplifies it on the way out.
flavour_texts: 🌑 **DARK VOID** — The Shadow Dragon King opens the abyss!
💀 The void swallows all light — true damage tears through every defense!
🐉 ABSOLUTE DARKNESS AWAKENS — THE DRAGON KING TRANSCENDS!

abilities.name: Absolute Darkness
abilities.description: After Dark Void is activated, Shadow Dragon King is consumed by absolute darkness — permanently increasing ALL stats by 55% of their CURRENT value, so the higher its level the larger the gain. This transformation is irreversible, and Dark Weather rages on through it.

chain._note: Absolute Darkness: +70% all stats permanently after Dark Void fires

steps._note: Absolute Darkness: +70% all stats permanently after Dark Void fires

abilities._note: The disable_ability_2 step that used to live here is what actually switched Dark Weather off — `disabled_after_special` on Dark Weather itself converts to nothing and never did anything. Removing it is what makes the passive always-on.

abilities.name: Dark Weather
abilities.description: A permanent black storm coils around the Shadow Dragon King and never lifts. The gloom hardens it and sharpens every strike — Attack and Defense are raised by 25, and Dark Void tears 25% deeper. The storm does not break when the abyss opens; even in Absolute Darkness, the weather still belongs to the dragon.
abilities._note: Authored as explicit rules below. The flat fields above are kept only so ;info and any other reader that inspects them still shows the right numbers — a `rules` block makes the engine ignore legacy fields entirely.

rules._note: once:battle + a 999-round duration is what makes this a STANDING +25/+25. As a plain passive it re-applied a 2-round buff every single round, and StatusManager.add_buff appends rather than replaces, so two entries were always live and the real value was +50/+50 — double what the card claimed.
Dark Weather: +25% Special Move damage, always.
